method: Built-in image_gen; eight separate image assets
style: Simple matte illustrated symbols, uniform light-purple circular backing baked into each PNG
shared_prompt:
Generate one production PNG image asset for an Android Home tool.
Use the attached eight-tools screenshot ONLY for the simple symbol's shape and restrained flat illustrated style. DO NOT copy the screenshot, labels, rectangular tiles, surrounding panel, or layout.
Subject: SUBJECT.
One centered simple 2D illustrated symbol. Flat, clean, rounded, friendly, matte. Very subtle depth at most. NOT realistic, NOT a scene, NOT glossy 3D, NOT metallic, no people with facial details, no scenery, no decorative objects.
Colors: symbol is rich royal purple #512395. Its backing is ONE uniform solid pale-lavender #EEE5FD circular disc, identical across all eight assets. No other accent colors. The CIRCULAR BACKGROUND AND ITS PADDING MUST BE BAKED INTO THE GENERATED IMAGE.
Square canvas. Perfect circular disc fills the entire canvas diameter, touching top, bottom, left, right; transparent alpha only outside the circle. Symbol centered and contained within 54% of the disc diameter, leaving generous even circular padding all around. Match the screenshot's symbol-to-tile proportion, but use a circle instead of its rounded square.
No text, letters, words, numbers, captions, watermarks, UI chrome, gradient circle background, grain, texture, bevels, sparkles, cast shadow outside the circle, or stray pixels.
Return ONE symbol on ONE circle, not a contact sheet.
